hook: so why are you still broke?
lines: #You got the raise. So why does it feel like *nothing* changed?
Because your *lifestyle* got the raise too.
A nicer car. A bigger place. More dinners *out.*
#It's called lifestyle *creep.*
And it's the quietest way to stay broke *forever.*
Every time you earn more, you spend *more.*
So the gap never *grows.*
Ten years later, they earn double...
and still live paycheck to *paycheck.*
Still stressed. Still one surprise bill away from *panic.*
#But wealth lives in the *gap.*
The space between what you make and what you *spend.*
So next time your income goes up, do something *different.*
Keep living like you *didn't* get it.
Send the difference somewhere it can *grow.*
#Nobody gets rich from their *salary.*
They get rich from what they *keep.*
Raise your income. Not your *lifestyle.*
Imagine a year from now. Same lifestyle. But a growing pile of *freedom.*
That's what discipline *buys* you.
Not stuff. *Options.*
Your future self is *counting* on that gap.
end: Save this for your next payday.

lines: MIND
